caveat: These goals are derived benchmarks, not a reconciled operating plan. The solver's schedule creates more pipeline than the targets need, because pipeline created to fund one quarter also lands in later ones, so its own bookings are shown beside the targets; target-equivalent wins come from the target, not from the schedule. Ownership, segment and quota have no history in the files, so today's values stand in for the plan start. The fit's estimator is chosen by the report's declared rule, scored on back-test folds cut at the plan date from what was known then; where too few folds exist at that date the rule keeps the incumbent (matured snapshots). A quarter whose entered target is zero has no target-equivalent wins, so the schedule's created deals for that quarter are shared by trailing-year bookings instead.

owner_caveat: An owner's goal is an allocated goal: the segment's goal shared by annual quota and the days employed in the year, from the roster as known at the plan date. Someone hired after that date has no original allocation. It is a planning allocation, never a measure of a person's performance, and what a person is shown to have produced is the record of their deals. Ownership has no history in the files, so a deal's owner today stands in for its owner then.
